actors.description: System administrator with full access rights

actors.name: PoliceOfficer
actors.description: Police personnel using the system for case management

actors.name: Citizen
actors.description: Public user accessing citizen interface features

actors.name: RecordsStaff

functions.name: TrackDefect
functions.description: Log and track application defects or enhancement requests
acceptance_criteria: User can submit defect with all required fields
Help desk can view defect reports by category/status/age
Users receive alerts when defect status changes

functions.name: ExportAudit
functions.description: Export audit trails for specified cases
acceptance_criteria: Audit data remains unaltered during export
Reports can be organized by case/user/chronology
functions.preconditions: Audit trail must exist for selected cases

functions.name: ManageAccess
functions.description: Configure user access rights to cases
acceptance_criteria: Only super-users can modify security attributes

functions.name: CustomizeUI
acceptance_criteria: UI remains accessible for special needs users

entities.name: Defect
entities.description: Reported application issue or enhancement request

attributes.name: recentCases
attributes.description: Quick access to frequently used cases

constraints.description: Provide context-sensitive help for all UI actions
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.
The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word "unalterable" is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

constraints.description: Restrict case access to specified users/groups
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.description: Save UI customizations in user profile
constraints.source_text: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

constraints.description: UI compatible with special needs software
constraints.source_text: The System user interface must be suitable for users with special needs; that is, compatible with specialist software that may be used and with appropriate interface guidelines

The System must be able to export audit trails for specified cases (without affecting the audit trail stored by the System). This functionality can be used by external auditors who wish to examine or analyse system activity.

The System must be able to capture and store violations (i.e. A user's attempts to access a case to which he is denied access), and (where violations can validly be attempted) attempted violations, of access control mechanisms.
The system should provide for role-based control for the functionality within the system
The solution should enable the user to track the submitted defect or enhancement request.

exceptions.trigger: User tries to access restricted case
exceptions.handling: Log violation and show configured response
Notify administrator and preserve original audit data

exceptions.trigger: Required fields missing in defect report
exceptions.handling: Show meaningful error message with guidance

non_functional_requirements.description: Simple search completes in 5-8 seconds, advanced search in 10-15 seconds
HTTPS protocol with SSL encryption for all communications
UI complies with ISO 9241 accessibility standards
Critical functionality available in offline mode
Supports deployment in police stations of varying sizes
